From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Ben Thompson <ben.thompson@novellahealth.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@novellahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-sale: Novella Health kickoff & ownership + deployment milestones

Team — looping in CS and ops so we can move from signature to kickoff. Quick summary and asks below.

Deal summary (short): Novella Health (pilot) — 3 model endpoints for clinical triage; target production date: 2026-10-15 (pilot window Sept–Nov). Committed monthly token volume: ~100k/day during pilot. SOW attached (Novella_SOW_v1.pdf).

Key milestones I’m tracking:
- 2026-08-30: kickoff call (30–45m) — confirmed availability in thread?
- 2026-09-06: environment & credentials provided to Redwood (Novella IT)
- 2026-09-13: integration smoke tests + sample payloads
- 2026-09-20: internal acceptance criteria / metrics defined

Requested owners (suggested):
- CS Lead / Onboarding owner: Mina Haddad — primary contact for runbook, training, success plan
- Implementation ops: Tessa Morgan — deployment checklist, infra coordination, capacity scheduling
- Sales escalation / commercial contact: Karthik Iyer — procurement & SOW edits post-sign

Action items for this email:
1) Mina: confirm you can take ownership and propose who from your team will be the day-to-day SE.
2) Novella (Ben/Priya): please confirm availability for 08/30 or propose alternate slots. Also confirm whether Novella requires EU data residency for the pilot (I believe US only, but flag if not).
3) Tessa: can you review the deployment checklist attached and call out any known constraints for the requested timeline?

Attachments: Novella_SOW_v1.pdf; novella_deployment_checklist.xlsx; redwood_kickoff_agenda.docx

Thanks — I’ll stay on this thread until Mina confirms and the first internal sync is scheduled.

— Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Jonas — happy to own the CS side.

Quick answers:
- I’ll be the CS lead. Day-to-day SE for this engagement will be Michael Grant (cc’d once I add him to the thread).
- I reviewed the SOW & checklist at a glance — nothing blocking but I want to confirm traffic patterns and expected peak TPS for batching config.
- For the 08/30 kickoff: I can do 09:00–11:00 PT or 14:00–16:00 PT.

Technical asks for Novella before kickoff (helps us scope the first two weeks):
- Service account and test credentials for the staging environment (least-privilege recommended).
- Example payloads and expected max sequence lengths (so we can pre-select quantization/latency targets).
- Any regulatory constraints (PII handling, audit log retention).

I’ll schedule an internal CS+Impln pre-call once I have Novella’s availability — goal is to align owners and finalize the kickoff agenda.

1) 08/30 at 10:00 PT works for us (Ben, Priya, and our Head of Data on the call).
2) Data residency: pilot will be US-only, though for Q4 planning we may require EU region — will flag if that changes.

Internal note / final prep before kickoff call:

- I reviewed novella_deployment_checklist.xlsx — looks doable for the requested timeline, but we should be explicit on the following dependencies:
  * Provisioned staging service account and test credentials (Ben ETA 09/03)
  * Network allowlist entries for Redwood staging IP range (Novella IT)
  * Expected peak tokens/sec so we can set batching window and GPU slot size

- I will reserve a single dedicated GPU for smoke tests on 09/13 (NVidia A100-equivalent) and a shadow slot for load tests on 09/20. If traffic projections change (>=2x tokens/day), we need a planning call to resize.

Mina — please confirm who will join the kickoff from CS (Michael Grant or alternate). Also call out any runbook items you want on the kickoff agenda (dev handoff, training, acceptance criteria).
